heading: Boolean aggregations
text:
### Boolean aggregations [LSER.16.8]

| Function | Meaning | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `bool_and(cursor)` | true iff every sample is true | `Bool?` |
| `bool_or(cursor)` | true iff any sample is true | `Bool?` |

Each is `null` exactly when the read is cold ([LSER.19.8]).
